description: Repository config. Only the managers listed here run: pip_requirements and pep621 are deliberately left out so pyproject.toml and the lockfiles are only ever changed through pip-compile (see thomas-lg/digestarr#174).

lockFileMaintenance.description: Refreshes transitive pins, which can cross a major version within the open constraints: reviewed by hand, unlike direct patch and minor bumps.

packageRules.description: pyproject.toml is also where requires-python and the build backend live; neither is a lockfile dependency, so leave them to humans.
Patch and minor land on develop by themselves, majors wait for a human.

A new Python minor is a runtime upgrade, not a routine bump: review it by hand even though semver calls it minor. One PR for every place that names it (both Dockerfiles, docker-compose.dev.yml, .python-version).

config:recommended types non-production dependencies as chore (:semanticPrefixFixDepsChoreOthers); every update here is a dependency bump, so keep the deps prefix that the PR title check, the labels and the release notes expect.

customManagers.description: The pip-tools Renovate compiles with (constraints.pipTools above) must match the one pinned in requirements-dev.txt, which the CI lockfile check uses; this keeps the constraint moving with the pin, in the same python-minor-patch PR.
Default Python image of the dev compose file, kept in step with .devcontainer/Dockerfile.dev and the production Dockerfile.
